selfDrive.title: Self-drive pricing
selfDrive.weekdayHint: The required base price for self-drive. Used on weekdays and as the fallback when no weekend price is set.
selfDrive.weekendHint: Leave empty to use the weekday price on weekends too.
selfDrive.hourlyHint: Leave empty if this vehicle is not rented by the hour.

discount.title: Instant discount
discount.info: Applies to the self-drive rental amount on quotes and new bookings; it does not reduce long-term prices, with-driver prices, surcharges or the deposit.
discount.percentInfo: Applies to the weekday price, the weekend price and per-day overrides of the self-drive service.
discount.offHint: Guests see the original price, with no discount label.
discount.previewEyebrow: What guests see on the marketplace
discount.previewEmpty: Enter a weekday price to preview it

longTerm.title: Long-term rental
longTerm.monthlyHint: The price of a single month. Customers pick a {packages} month package; without this price the vehicle cannot be published for long-term rental.

withDriver.title: With driver
withDriver.dailyHint: Required to publish the with-driver service.
withDriver.interCityHint: Leave empty to estimate from the in-city price; surcharges are confirmed on approval.
withDriver.oneWayHint: Leave empty to fall back to the nearest tier: inter-city, then in-city.

deposit.title: Security requirement (collateral)
deposit.amountHint: A fixed VND amount collected separately from the rental price. Not discounted, and applied to new bookings only.
deposit.assetTypesHint: The customer only needs to meet ONE of the selected options.
deposit.noneBody: Vehicles on this policy show the “No collateral” badge and can be filtered by it on the marketplace.
deposit.hint: Collateral is what the shop holds against risk: a cash deposit, an asset or document, or nothing at all. This is SEPARATE from checking the renter’s ID — that happens on every rental.
deposit.modeCash: The renter leaves a sum of money, refunded once handover is complete.
deposit.modeAsset: The renter leaves a document or asset instead of money — the shop holds no cash.
deposit.modeNone: No collateral required. The vehicle carries a "No collateral" tag on the marketplace.

delivery.title: Door-to-door delivery
delivery.hint: The fee follows the one-way road distance from the shop to the pickup point.
delivery.maxRadiusHint: This must match the end of the last band. Beyond the radius renters see "Contact the owner" and the shop quotes delivery manually.
delivery.disabledNote: Off — renters cannot request delivery when booking.

overtime.title: Agreed late-return fee
overtime.hint: The late fee is computed at handover, after the grace period and using the configured rounding unit.
overtime.feePerHourHint: The charge for each hour the renter is late beyond the grace period.
overtime.graceMinutesHint: How late a return can be before any fee applies.
overtime.roundingMinutesHint: The smallest time step used when rounding the fee.
overtime.formula: Late fee = (actual hours late) × {fee}. Computed at handover.
overtime.formulaNone: No hourly fee set — the late fee will be agreed manually at handover.

longTermDiscount.title: Duration commitment discount (long-term)
longTermDiscount.hint: Long-term rentals only. Renters get the highest tier their package reaches, and tiers do not stack; a 9-month package uses the 6-month tier when no higher tier exists.
longTermDiscount.disabledNote: Off — every booking is charged the base rate.

inherited.title: Inherited policy in effect

inherited.subtitle: Collateral, delivery and duration discounts are inherited from the shop.
inherited.subtitleEmpty: The shop has no collateral, delivery or duration-discount policy yet.
inherited.emptyBody: This vehicle has no collateral, delivery or discount rules. Set them in the shop rental policy, or switch to a per-vehicle override.

confirm.inheritBody: The new price applies to {vehicle} only, from new bookings onward. The vehicle still inherits the shop-wide policy.
